A light object is dropped from rest. It falls a large distance vertically through air.
How can the motion of the object be described?
A
constant acceleration
B
increasing acceleration
C
decreasing acceleration and then moving at terminal velocity
D
increasing acceleration and then moving at terminal velocity

options.label: C
options.text: decreasing acceleration and then moving at terminal velocity

options.label: D
options.text: increasing acceleration and then moving at terminal velocity
